title: Constraint-native quantum control for fidelity--complexity trade-offs with inexact proximal ADMM
summary: Quantum-control pulses are often optimised for nominal fidelity before waveform constraints are imposed. This sequence can conceal the fidelity cost of producing smooth, band-limited, and amplitude-admissible controls. Here, we evaluate a constraint-native alternative based on inexact proximal alternating-direction updates. The formulation combines gate-infidelity minimisation with amplitude bounds, Fourier-domain bandwidth projection, amplitude sparsity, and total-variation regularisation.
